_about: The goop's faces (F62): eyes, worried brows and mouths that grow on the goop as the story goes on, in both goo styles (Jelly and Particle). Muzzy's picks from the sketch, 2026-10-24 (research/goop-eyes/picks.json, sketch research/sketches/goop-eyes.html). By rank: 0–9 none · 10–19 a few tiny eyes in big clumps, shut when zapped · 20–29 eyes in most clumps, following the falling piece (the laser's tap while it fires) · 30–39 they blink and look worried when pressure is high · 40+ some clumps grow mouths, shut most of the time, now and then saying something. Eyes, brows and mouths show up (and go) one clump at a time. Drawn inside the goo, smooth (the pixel look will be one shared shader later). Sizes and distances in cells (1 = one grid square), times in seconds (the goo's clock: the Dev Kit pause stops them). Numbers and colours only; keys starting with _ are notes.

_help.eyeSize: How big each eye is (cells). 0.1 = a speck you have to look for; 0.25 = cartoon eyes.
_help.pupilSize: How much of the eye the pupil fills. Small = staring and creepy; big = cute.
_help.eyeGap: How far apart the eyes sit (cells). 0 = they overlap into one blob.
_help.eyeCount: How many eyes a clump with eyes gets, in a row. 3+ starts to feel alien.
_help.pupilColor: The pupils (and the brows and closed-eye lines).
_help.minClump10: Rank 10–19: only clumps at least this many cells big can open eyes.
_help.eyeChance10: Rank 10–19: chance each big-enough clump has eyes. Low = "a few", you have to spot them. Each clump keeps its own roll.
_help.minClump20: Rank 20+: the smallest clump with eyes once they are "in most clumps".
_help.eyeChance20: Rank 20+: chance each big-enough clump has eyes.
_help.followSpeed: Rank 20+: how quickly the pupils swing to the falling piece, or the laser while it fires. Low = lazy, high = snappy.
_help.followRange: Rank 20+: only clumps this close (cells) to the piece follow it; the rest look ahead.
_help.blinkEvery: Rank 30+: seconds between blinks. Each clump blinks on its own clock (50–150% of this).
_help.blinkTime: Rank 30+: how long one blink takes. Long = sleepy.
_help.worriedAt: Rank 30+: when pressure passes this (0–1), the eyes look worried (brows, small shaky pupils).
_help.browTilt: Rank 30+: how steep the worried brows are (degrees, inner ends up). 0 = no brows.
_help.pupilShrink: Rank 30+: how much the pupils shrink when worried (0.4 = 40% smaller at full pressure).
_help.zapClose: Seconds the clumps touching a zapped goop squeeze their eyes shut (> <). The zapped one shuts at once.
_help.mouthChance: Rank 40+: chance a clump with eyes also has a mouth.
_help.mouthSize: Rank 40+: how wide the mouths are (cells).
_help.mouthOpen: Rank 40+: how wide a mouth opens when it says something (0 = it never opens). Shut the rest of the time.
_help.talkEvery: Rank 40+: average seconds between one mouth's sayings. Each wait is random (30–170% of this), so they never talk in step. High = rare.
_help.talkTime: Rank 40+: how long one saying lasts (a few quick flaps).
_help.appearSpread: Eyes (a new clump, or a new rank), brows (pressure passes Worried at) and mouths show up one clump at a time, at random moments within this many seconds. Leaving goes the same way.
_help.appearFade: How quickly one clump's eyes / brows / mouth fade in or out once its turn comes (seconds).
_help.talkFlaps: Rank 40+: how fast a mouth flaps while it says something (each clump 70–130% of this).
_help.mouthDrop: Rank 40+: how far below the eyes' spot the mouth sits (cells).
_help.eyeLift: Rank 40+: how far the eyes move up to make room for a mouth (cells), as the mouth fades in.
_help.browHeight: Rank 30+: how high the worried brows sit above the eyes (in eye sizes).
_help.worriedShake: Rank 30+: how much the worried pupils tremble (share of the eye). 0 = still.
